title: [DocDB] LeakSanitizer: memory leak DocRowwiseIteratorTest.LargeKeysTest in yb::docdb::KeyEntryValue::DecodeKey
body:
Jira Link: [DB-5368](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5368)
### Description

DocRowwiseIteratorTest.LargeKeysTest has a one time (so far) leak in the build http://jenkins.dev.yugabyte.com/job/github-yugabyte-db-alma8-master-clang15-asan/364/ after [commit](https://phabricator.dev.yugabyte.com/rYBDB45ca13c368cfaa1f1995656290c0eb74ce5cb931) .
The next build doesn't have this error.

Detective page: https://detective.dev.yugabyte.com/?commits=45ca13c368cfaa1f1995656290c0eb74ce5cb931

Error:
